Name: The Daycare and the Abbey
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
ChaseXavier and delfargo left permissions open for their NPCs so I decided to pick up some of their old projects. Here's one of the bigger ones! I have updated and completely rewritten these old works.


Presenting...the Daycare and the Abbey!

This mod adds a daycare and an abbey to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project - Expanded Map for Custom NPCs[/url]. It includes 2 new buildings and 5 new NPCs! (2 romanceable! Optional seasonal outfits included!) 


Meadowlark Daycare:


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56069/56069-1795711977-791709053.png[/img]
Pilla is one of the twins that runs Meadowlark Daycare. She's an outgoing fashionista that handles the day-to-day office duties and is fully romanceable.

Gift tastes: 
Loves: Chicken Statue, Rainbow Shell
Likes: Joja Cola, Coffee, Wine, Beer, Pale Ale
Dislikes: Pickles, Mayo, Duck Mayo, Void Mayo
Hate: Daffodil, Dandelion, Trash

Heart Events: 
Intro - Daycare, 6 am-8 pm
2 heart - Downhill, sunny, 10 am-4 pm
4 heart - Town, sunny, 10 am-4 pm
6 heart - Mountain, rainy, 9 am-2 pm
8 heart - Downhill, sunny, 8 am-4 pm
10 heart - Farm, 4 pm-8 pm

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56069/56069-1795712075-410653059.png[/img]
Yamani is one of the twins that runs Meadowlark Daycare. She's more hands-on than her sister and takes care of the children. She is fully romanceable.

Gift tastes: 
Loves: Chicken Statue, Rainbow Shell
Likes: Juice, Coffee, Energy Tonic, Triple Shot Espresso
Dislikes: Beer, Wine
Hate: Daffodil, Dandelion, Trash

Heart Events: 
Intro - Daycare, 6 am-8 pm
2 heart - Daycare, 9 am-5 pm
4 heart - Daycare, 9 am-5 pm
6 heart - Library, 11 am-4 pm
8 heart - Beach, 9 am-4 pm, rainy
10 heart - Farm, 6 am-12pm, sunny


The Abbey:

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56069/56069-1795712163-324602266.png[/img]
Sister Rose is one of the nuns in the local abbey. She is the proprietress of Meadowlark Daycare and cares deeply for the valley's children.

Gift tastes: 
Loves: Tea set, Green Tea, Bruschetta, Fruit Salad, Pumpkin Pie
Likes: Tea Leaves, Eggs, Milks
Dislikes: Joja Cola, Juice, Energy Tonic, Coffee, Triple Shot Espresso
Hate: Beer, Pale Ale

Heart Events: 
3 hearts - Downhill, 12 pm-5 pm, sunny
5 hearts -  Abbey, 8 am-2 pm
7 hearts - Town, 10 am-5 pm, sunny

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56069/56069-1795712230-924223841.png[/img]
Sister Henry is one of the nuns from the local abbey. She comes off harsh, but secretly has a heart of gold.

Gift tastes: 
Loves: Tea set, Green Tea, Bruschetta, Fruit Salad, Pumpkin Pie
Likes: Tea Leaves, Eggs, Milks
Dislikes: Joja Cola, Juice, Energy Tonic, Coffee, Triple Shot Espresso
Hate: Beer, Pale Ale

Heart Events: 
3 hearts - Downhill, 7 am-3 pm, sunny
5 hearts -  Town, 11 am-3 pm, sunny
7 hearts - Downhill, 9 am-3 pm, sunny

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/56069/56069-1795712278-631453359.png[/img]
Sonnet is an orphan that stays at the abbey. She loves, LOVES dinosaurs and visiting her 'imaginary' friend, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54602]Muadhnait[/url].

Gift tastes:
Loves: anything with bones and fossils
Likes: flowers
Dislikes: vegetables
Hate: alcohol

Heart Events: 
3 hearts - Abbey, 9 am-5 pm
5 hearts -  Town, 12 pm-4pm, sunny
7 hearts - Library, 11 am-3 pm, sunny

This mod contains cross-over content with my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54602]Muadhnait Revived[/url]. Download both for the full story!
Enjoy this new add-on! But beware the backroom at the daycare!

***NOTE: IF YOU HAVE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48693]THE BRIDUNOW BROTHERS[/url] MAKE SURE TO DOWNLOAD THE LATEST UPDATE,  AS THEIR HOUSE HAS BEEN MOVED TO ACCOMODATE THE DAYCARE LOCATION

***NOTE2: IF INSTALLING MID-GAME [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44842]JP'S RESET TERRAIN FEATURES OMEGA[/url] IS NEEDED TO CLEAR THE LAND FOR THE BUILDINGS IN THIS MOD


Enjoy!
